name: Why is proper ventilation important for bathtub plumbing during a remodel?

mainEntity.name: Why is proper ventilation important for bathtub plumbing during a remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Proper ventilation is crucial for bathtub plumbing during a remodel because it prevents sewer gases from entering your home and ensures efficient drainage. A correctly vented system allows air to enter the drain pipes, balancing the pressure and preventing a vacuum from forming. Without adequate venting, water can be siphoned out of the P-trap, allowing odors to escape, or drains can become slow and gurgling. We ensure that all new or modified plumbing adheres to venting codes for optimal system performance and safety.
